parentalGuide.title: What you should know before deciding
parentalGuide.intro: This page is for the parent or guardian. It explains what LES STAGIAIRES is, what your consent allows, and what it does not.

whatIsIt.title: What is LES STAGIAIRES?
whatIsIt.body: A platform connecting young people with companies and institutions offering internships, apprenticeships and first work experiences. Registration is free for the young person.

guarantees.title: Safeguards for your child
guarantees.blocked: Without your consent, they cannot apply, sign an internship agreement, or share a document. They can only browse and build their profile.
guarantees.visibility: Their profile is set to reduced visibility by default, without any action on their part.
guarantees.documents: Their documents (diplomas, identity papers) are encrypted and shared only with people they explicitly choose.
guarantees.revoke: You can withdraw your consent at any time; the account then returns to restricted mode.
guarantees.noSale: Their data is never sold or passed to third parties for advertising.
guarantees.report: A reporting channel (harassment, abuse, danger) is available in the app at any time.

whatConsentOpens.title: What consent would open
whatConsentOpens.body: Applying to an offer, accepting a proposal, signing an internship agreement, travelling as part of an internship, and sharing documents with a company. Nothing else changes.

rightToRefuse.title: You have the right to refuse
rightToRefuse.body: Refusing is a legitimate answer and is recorded as such. Your child keeps their account in restricted mode and loses nothing they have prepared. They may ask you again later, after a waiting period — first one week, then one month, then six months. That delay exists precisely so your decision is respected and you are not asked again endlessly.

howToAnswer.title: How to answer
howToAnswer.body: You received an SMS with a link and a six-digit code. Open that link on your own phone: you can then give or refuse your consent.
howToAnswer.notHere: The decision is not made on this screen, nor on your child’s phone. It is made only from the link sent to yours.

guardianChange.title: Change of legal guardian
guardianChange.intro: This applies to a genuine change of situation: bereavement, separation, foster care, relocation. It is reviewed by a member of our team, and is not an appeal against a refusal.

matchReason.OCCUPATION: Matches the job you are aiming for

qualityAdvice.SKILLS_DECLARED: Declare the expected skills: without them, your opportunity cannot be matched to any profile on what it actually requires.
qualityAdvice.OCCUPATION_LINKED: Link a job: your opportunity does not reach candidates aiming for that job or its family.
qualityAdvice.DESCRIPTION_SUBSTANTIAL: Describe the assignments more precisely: this is what candidates read before applying.
qualityAdvice.TITLE_INFORMATIVE: Make the job title clearer: a two-word title does not say what the role is.
qualityAdvice.START_DATE_SET: State the start date if you know it: candidates available then will see your opportunity more easily.
qualityAdvice.STILL_FRESH: This opportunity has been published for over two months. Refresh it, or close it if the position is filled.
qualityAdvice.EDUCATION_STATED: State the expected education level: candidates will know whether they can apply. Leaving it out excludes no one.
qualityAdvice.LOCATION_USABLE: Give the city, or choose remote: candidates must know whether they can take this position.
